MAKE IT YOURS

Find your flow.

Drag anywhere on the board to move the paddle. Hit its edges to change the bounce angle. Catch falling boosts. At 100% charge, tap Pulse to clear up to 100 bricks.

Keyboard: ← → or A / D to move · Space to launch · P / Escape to pause · X for pulse.

Arcade progress saves at the start of each stage. Zen has a permanent safety floor and a separate best score. Scores stay on this device.
